What this proposes

The squad owns the large card-hex surface. A colored left sub-facet carries the faction; a pale right sub-facet carries the denomination. Tap any squad socket to place/remove a sample.

Six different topographies are schematic sketches, not new terrain generators or a 3D world viewer. The tiny squads are renders of the new reusable 3D troop models.

Still open: six fields replace the earlier nine-field assumption. Adjacency and victory thresholds need a separate rule decision. The old three-adjacent/five-total rule is not asserted here.

Battle flow retained

Declare → squad hexes join → stone walls topple → shared laser printing transfers squads into the battlefield → 3, 2, 1 → ambient scuffles, wavering standards, retreat/surrender → winner’s clan medallion.

This page compares layout only. Rules, tactics, ten troop types, clan shields and battle presentation remain in the separate implementation work.
